notes: Weapon definitions. sim.js reads ONLY this file for weapon behaviour; add a weapon by adding an entry, not code.
fire: 'hitscan' (instant rays, `pellets` per shot for shotguns), 'projectile' (thrown/launched, explodes), 'melee'.
Angles are radians. Spread is the gaussian sigma of the aim error per ray. Distances are metres, times seconds.
Hitboxes: body cylinder r=0.42 h=1.42, head sphere r=0.25 at 1.62 (sim.js BODY). Headshot = damage.head.
TTK sanity: body hits to kill = ceil(100 / damage.body). Keep ARs at 4-5, SMGs 5-6 at their faster interval.

The 8 launch weapons from the GDD: allowance (AR), sideHustle (SMG), divorceSettlement (shotgun), trustFund (sniper), subdivision (LMG), permit (pistol), lawsuit (launcher; here as thrown briefcase), participationTrophy (melee). Missing ones are TODO for the systems AI.
